title: Launch playlist for adding a new model to the catalog (benchmarks, docs, release notes, comms)
creator: Priya Nambiar
description:
Purpose: A single, pragmatic launch playlist to coordinate cross-functional work required to add a new model variant to the Redwood Model Catalog. This ticket bundles launch readiness gates across benchmarks, docs, SDK examples, release notes, and go-to-market comms so the launch is repeatable and auditable.

Scope: catalog entry + performance/quality profiles, benchmark results and artifacts, migration and compatibility guidance, release notes with breaking/compatibility callouts, docs and code samples, marketing & community announcements, and monitoring runbooks.

Acceptance criteria: All checklist items below completed, PRs merged or have explicit follow-ups, final release notes approved by PM & Legal, SDK samples merged, benchmarks reproducible and uploaded to Drive, observability dashboards in Console linked and smoke-tested, and an owned rollback plan documented.

Checklist (actionable items):
1) Catalog entry and model metadata:
- Add model metadata draft (name, architecture, tokenizer, recommended variants, quantization notes, license) -> owner: ML Content (Diego)
- Finalize performance profile (latency/cost per token at 128/512 tokens) -> owner: Runtime Eng (Avery Chen)
- Create model tags and search keywords for console filtering -> owner: Product Ops (Lina Park)

2) Benchmarks & quality artifacts:
- Run standard benchmark suite (throughput, p99 latency, mem, quantized variants) -> owner: Perf Eng (Avery Chen)
- Run accuracy/LLM-evals on core workloads (classification, summarization, instruction-following tests) -> owner: Applied ML (Ravi Singh)
- Upload raw benchmark artifacts and scripts to Drive -> link: https://drive.redwood.ai/models/PM-4310/benchmarks -> owner: Ravi Singh
- Include a short paragraph in release notes summarizing trade-offs (latency vs quality) -> owner: PM (Priya)
